mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers a market reassessment of economic growth prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a market repricing of equity valuations due to higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the regime where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates weakening economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a strong economic recovery supported by accommodative monetary policy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and decline in FEDFUNDS does not produce positive 5-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a sector-specific slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, a decline in HOUST does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
